summary: @servicetitan/docs-anvil-uikit-contrib preinstall hook executes obfuscated payload via bundled Bun runtime
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from GitHub oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the platform-specific `bun` binary to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-cjs file (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) whose body is a rotating string-array / char-code decoder with hex-named locals and no readable identifiers — a hand-obfuscated payload not amenable to static review. The advertised purpose of the package is documentation content for a Docusaurus UI kit, which has no legitimate need for an alternate runtime or an opaque install-time script. The install-time chain — preinstall lifecycle hook → download an alternate runtime → execute a bundled obfuscated payload under that runtime — evades scanners that only trace Node-resolved code, and runs automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
